name: Horik Sol
source:
Owner of the Kokono Kokono cafe.
Ten years ago he started taking care of the protagonist who had lost all her relatives, they currently live together.
He possesses the glamor of an adult combined with a tolerant personality, a "wise man", or possibly just an "eccentric". 
Because he sometimes does things that transcend common sense, the meaning of his words is occasionally hard to understand.

His outward face is just a cafe owner, however his true personality is shrouded in mystery.
